welcome.heading: Welcome aboard, {fullName}!
welcome.body1: We are thrilled to have you join OmniServices. Your account is now active and ready to use.
welcome.body2: Explore our platform and start managing your workspace seamlessly.
welcome.supportText: If you have any questions, our support team is always here to help.

supplierWelcome.subject: Welcome to OmniServices Partner Network!
supplierWelcome.heading: Welcome to the Partner Network, {fullName}!
supplierWelcome.body1: Congratulations on successfully registering your supplier account with OmniServices. We are thrilled to partner with your business.
supplierWelcome.body2: Your supplier account is now active. Follow these next steps to start selling and managing your catalog on OmniServices:
supplierWelcome.step1Desc: Provide your business details, tax information, and banking details for verified payouts.
supplierWelcome.step2Desc: Upload your products, configure inventory, and define pricing tiers.
supplierWelcome.step3Desc: Manage orders, monitor fulfillments, and track analytics from your Supplier Portal.
supplierWelcome.supportText: Need assistance with onboarding? Our dedicated Partner Support team is here to guide you every step of the way.

otp.heading: Your Verification Code
otp.body: Use the following One-Time Password (OTP) to complete your verification. This code is confidential and valid for a single use.
otp.securityNoticeBody: Never share this code with anyone. OmniServices representatives will never ask you for your verification code or password.
otp.disclaimerText: If you did not request this verification code, please ignore this email or review your account security settings immediately.

verification.heading: Verify your email address
verification.body: Thank you for signing up with OmniServices. Please verify your email address to activate your full account features.
verification.orText: If the button above does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
verification.disclaimerText: If you did not create an account with OmniServices, please ignore this email.

resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset your OmniServices password. Click the button below to choose a new password:
resetPassword.orText: If the button above does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
resetPassword.securityText: This password reset link will expire soon. If you did not make this request, please ignore this email or contact support immediately.

changePasswordOtp.heading: Verify Your Password Change
changePasswordOtp.body: We received a request to change your password. To proceed with this change, please use the following One-Time Password (OTP).
changePasswordOtp.securityNoticeBody: Never share this code with anyone. OmniServices representatives will never ask you for your verification code or password. If you did not request this password change, please secure your account immediately.
changePasswordOtp.disclaimerText: If you did not request this password change, please ignore this email and consider reviewing your account security settings.
